purpose: Teach: 最古/三振/高地/産学/海賊版/長け/ショールーム/師団

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界最古、つまり最古参の老舗との取引を大事にしろ
lines.en: Treat our dealings with the industry's oldest house — its most senior establishment — with care.
lines.style: Low, deliberate opening; each word placed with weight, firm landing on the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。野球部の社員が三振王になった事を社内で祝います
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll celebrate company-wide that our man on the baseball team became the strikeout king.
lines.style: Prompt, crisp acknowledgment; a small warm lift on the celebration, then back to business.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、高地、つまり高地栽培の食材調達を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our sourcing of highland ingredients — high-altitude cultivation.
lines.style: Measured directive; brief clarifying pause mid-line, then the order delivered flat and final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。産学、つまり産学連携の研究費を確保します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll secure the research budget for the industry-academia partnership.
lines.style: Steady, ready compliance; efficient pace, slight confident stress on securing the funding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海賊版商品の市場流出を防げ
lines.en: Keep pirated versions of our products from leaking into the market.
lines.style: Harder edge without raising volume; clipped consonants, the warning left hanging deliberately.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マーケティングに長けた人材を採用します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll hire people who truly excel at marketing.
lines.style: Even, assured reply; matter-of-fact rhythm with a faint tired steadiness underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品のショールームを駅前に開け
lines.en: Open a showroom for the new products right in front of the station.
lines.style: Decisive, forward-leaning order; slightly quickened, the location landing like a pin on a map.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。防災で師団、つまり師団規模の訓練に参加します
lines.en: Yes, sir. For disaster preparedness, we'll take part in a division-scale drill — a whole army division's worth.
lines.style: Closing confirmation, respectful and complete; brief clarifying beat, then a firm final period.
